dialogue_texts: Kotori was supposed to have cleaned up all the mail. Why is it still here?
No clue. I also didn't take the chance to introduce myself to you.
I am Hiroyuki Shirogane, the head of the mansion, but you can just call me Shirogane-sama.
But look ahead... that red haze. Don't tell me...
Leave me alone... the mail... society... I don't need any of it anymore.
Seriously!? The glohm has now reached Kozankyo!?
Look at Kotori! She's completely glohmed! What happened to her crucial deadline?
Deadlines are just noise. The Order promised me absolute silence in the dark.
No more screaming humanoids waiting for lost letters...
Her danmaku will be much more powerful while she's under the curse, and it might spread to you!
I've handed out summary judgments for worse than this.
As the Chief Justice, I order you to stand down and accept your purification!
You want to break my quiet time? I'll bury you in the dark!
